So I asked AI and he gave me this command to sign the application, after that installation worked flawlessly:

```bash
//Generating the key
└─$ keytool -genkey -v -keystore .debug.keystore -storepass android -alias androiddebugkey -keypass android -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 -validity 10000 -dname "CN=Android Debug,O=Android,C=US"
Generating 2,048 bit RSA key pair and self-signed certificate (SHA384withRSA) with a validity of 10,000 days
    for: CN=Android Debug, O=Android, C=US
[Storing .debug.keystore]

//Signing
apksigner sign --ks .debug.keystore --ks-pass pass:android --key-pass pass:android hackfail-authenticator.apk

//Verify
└─$ apksigner verify -v hackfail-authenticator.apk
Verifies

Verified using v4 scheme (APK Signature Scheme v4): false
```

# Digging the APK

Now that i have the application I see it damn requires a password? Here I will not be able to post why but basically it uses a faulty implementation of chacha20:

![e2d0ba7800b41045117893210b7c3dcd.png](../../../_resources/e2d0ba7800b41045117893210b7c3dcd.png)

```java
package com.hackfail.authenticator;

import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.ByteOrder;
import java.util.Arrays;

public class ChaCha20 {

    }

    private static byte[] intToBytes(int i) {
        return ByteBuffer.allocate(4).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).putInt(i).array();
    }

    public byte[] decrypt(byte[] bArr, byte[] bArr2, byte[] bArr3) {

    }

    public byte[] encrypt(byte[] bArr, byte[] bArr2, byte[] bArr3) {
        this.counter = 1;

                innerBlock();
            }
            byte[] bArr5 = new byte[this.state.length * 4];
            int i3 = 0;
            while (true) {
                int[] iArr = this.state;
                if (i3 >= iArr.length) {
                    break;
                }
                byte[] bArrIntToBytes = intToBytes(iArr[i3]);
                for (int i4 = 0; i4 < bArrIntToBytes.length; i4++) {
                    bArr5[(i3 * 4) + i4] = bArrIntToBytes[i4];
                }
                i3++;
            }
            int i5 = i + 64;
            int iMin = Math.min(bArr.length, i5);
            for (int i6 = i; i6 < iMin; i6++) {
                bArr4[i6] = (byte) (bArr[i6] ^ bArr5[i6 - i]);
            }
            this.counter++;
            i = i5;
        }
        return bArr4;
    }

    private void initState(byte[] bArr, byte[] bArr2) {
        int[] iArr = this.state;
        iArr[0] = 1634760805;
        iArr[1] = 857760878;
        iArr[2] = 2036477234;
        iArr[3] = 1797285236;
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
            int i2 = i * 4;
            this.state[i + 4] = bytesToInt(Arrays.copyOfRange(bArr, i2, i2 + 4));
        }
        this.state[12] = this.counter;
        for (int i3 = 0; i3 < 3; i3++) {
            int i4 = i3 * 4;
            this.state[i3 + 13] = bytesToInt(Arrays.copyOfRange(bArr2, i4, i4 + 4));
        }
    }

    private void innerBlock() {
        quarterRound(0, 4, 8, 12);
        quarterRound(1, 5, 9, 13);
        quarterRound(2, 6, 10, 14);
        quarterRound(3, 7, 11, 15);
        quarterRound(0, 5, 10, 15);
        quarterRound(1, 6, 11, 12);
        quarterRound(2, 7, 8, 13);
        quarterRound(3, 4, 9, 14);
    }

    private void quarterRound(int i, int i2, int i3, int i4) {
        int[] iArr = this.state;
        iArr[i] = iArr[i] + iArr[i2];
        iArr[i4] = iArr[i4] ^ iArr[i];
        iArr[i4] = Integer.rotateLeft(iArr[i4], 16);
        int[] iArr2 = this.state;
        iArr2[i3] = iArr2[i3] + iArr2[i4];
        iArr2[i2] = iArr2[i2] ^ iArr2[i3];
        iArr2[i2] = Integer.rotateLeft(iArr2[i2], 12);
        int[] iArr3 = this.state;
        iArr3[i] = iArr3[i] + iArr3[i2];
        iArr3[i4] = iArr3[i] ^ iArr3[i4];
```

By using this code it is possible obtaining the third flag:

```python
import struct

# =========================
# Known data from APK
# =========================

PLAINTEXT = b"Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetuer adipiscing elit. Aenean commodo ligula."

CIPHERTEXT = bytes([
    106, 91, 19, 174, 33, 189, 6, 178, 66, 110, 180, 197, 251, 230, 240, 196,
    50, 195, 226, 78, 144, 77, 175, 110, 6, 64, 99, 220, 187, 93, 157, 217,
    83, 189, 133, 224, 56, 162, 235, 43, 148, 149, 227, 223, 253, 88, 224,
    204, 39, 90, 30, 111, 15, 210, 98, 191, 83, 113, 186, 184, 150, 146, 86,
    183, 137, 188, 102, 201, 200, 246, 48, 58, 33, 214, 64, 9, 37, 224, 86, 255
])

# =========================
# Helpers
# =========================

def rotr(x, n):
    return ((x >> n) | (x << (32 - n))) & 0xffffffff

def inv_quarter_round(s, a, b, c, d):
    s[b] = rotr(s[b], 7)
    s[b] ^= s[c]
    s[c] = (s[c] - s[d]) & 0xffffffff

    s[d] = rotr(s[d], 8)
    s[d] ^= s[a]
    s[a] = (s[a] - s[b]) & 0xffffffff

    s[b] = rotr(s[b], 12)
    s[b] ^= s[c]
    s[c] = (s[c] - s[d]) & 0xffffffff

    s[d] = rotr(s[d], 16)
    s[d] ^= s[a]
    s[a] = (s[a] - s[b]) & 0xffffffff

# =========================
# Step 1: recover keystream
# =========================

keystream = bytes(p ^ c for p, c in zip(PLAINTEXT, CIPHERTEXT))

# First 64 bytes form the ChaCha state
state = list(struct.unpack("<16I", keystream[:64]))

# =========================
# Step 2: invert 20 rounds
# =========================

for _ in range(10):
    inv_quarter_round(state, 3, 4, 9, 14)
    inv_quarter_round(state, 2, 7, 8, 13)
    inv_quarter_round(state, 1, 6, 11, 12)
    inv_quarter_round(state, 0, 5, 10, 15)

    inv_quarter_round(state, 3, 7, 11, 15)
    inv_quarter_round(state, 2, 6, 10, 14)
    inv_quarter_round(state, 1, 5, 9, 13)
    inv_quarter_round(state, 0, 4, 8, 12)

# =========================
# Step 3: extract password
# =========================

key_words = state[4:12]
password = b"".join(struct.pack("<I", w) for w in key_words)

print("[+] Recovered password (raw bytes):")
print(password)

try:
    print("\n[+] ASCII representation:")
    print(password.decode())
except UnicodeDecodeError:
    print("\n[!] Password is not pure ASCII")

```
